body: Social Security Regulations 2018 regulation 50 specifies a special category of eligibility for disability allowance under section 85(1)(b). MSD may grant a disability allowance to a person who would otherwise be eligible but whose life expectancy is less than 6 months, or for whom it is not possible to determine whether the disability is likely to continue for at least 6 months but that is a reasonably possible prognosis.

Social Security Regulations 2018 regulation 51 specifies a special category of eligibility for disability allowance under section 85(1)(b) and (3). It applies if a person whose application was declined only because the disability was likely to last less than 6 months later satisfies MSD that the disability is likely to last, or has continued, for 6 months or more and the person would otherwise have been eligible from the original application date. MSD must grant the disability allowance commencing on the date of the original application.

Social Security Regulations 2018 regulation 52 prescribes, for the purposes of Social Security Act 2018 section 88, a health practitioner who is acting within their scope of practice and is either a medical practitioner or a nurse practitioner.
